dogecoin.text:
This “underlying dogecoin thesis” was apparent in 2016.

IYKYK 😉

Dogecoin not only survives, but thrives, because of the explicit lack of seriousness in the community. Giveaways, charitable organizing, inclusion, such wow, etc.

The dogecoin community is a safe place to learn the basics of systems like bitcoin. It’s a gateway drug.

Dogecoin is an established POW network with low fees and high transaction throughput.

When folks tried to hijack bitcoin for the sake of low fees and higher transaction throughput, one could point to litecoin or dogecoin as an example of such networks.
